title: Dispatch: cim4 (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Plan for parent eshyra-cim4 (bd show eshyra-cim4). Decisions made; STOP and note if code contradicts.
WORKTREE: .worktrees/eshyra-cim4.1 (branch eshyra-cim4.1 from origin/main). Deps installed. Do not edit packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts or its tests (parallel task).

SRD: both Flexible Casting operations take "a bonus action on your turn".
CODE: packages/core/src/state/flexibleCasting.ts (flexibleCasting(), one transaction; result has actionCost); packages/core/src/state/actionEconomy.ts spendTurnResource(db, SpendTurnResourceInput) (~line 1032; resource 'bonus_action'; enforces whose turn it is, already-used, surprised); orchestrator/toolFlexibleCasting.ts (description currently says the DM tracks the bonus action); protocol.ts sentence.

DECISIONS
1. When the campaign has an ACTIVE combat instance, flexibleCasting spends the character's bonus action through spendTurnResource (resource 'bonus_action', participant = the character, activity e.g. 'Flexible Casting: create level N slot' / 'convert level N slot') INSIDE the same transaction, BEFORE any point/slot mutation, so any refusal (not this character's turn, bonus action already used, surprised) aborts atomically and surfaces as a FlexibleCastingError with the action-economy message. Do not pass spellRef (this is not a spell cast).
2. Outside active combat: no action-economy consumption (turn timing only exists in structured combat); unchanged behaviour.
3. Update the tool description and protocol sentence: the tool spends the bonus action itself in combat; do not also call spend_turn_resource.
4. Result: include whether a bonus action was spent (e.g. bonusActionSpent: true) in combat.

EVIDENCE: in combat on the sorcerer's turn: create succeeds and the turn budget shows the bonus action used; a second flexible_casting the same turn is refused with nothing changed; on another participant's turn refused; outside combat unchanged (existing tests). Reuse existing combat/turn fixtures from actionEconomy or flexibleCasting tests.
PROTOCOL: npm run verify:worktree BEFORE commit; commit (Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>); bd update eshyra-cim4.1 --append-notes; bd close eshyra-cim4.1. No push/PR.
notes: Done at bc926812: flexibleCasting spends bonus_action via spendTurnResource in-transaction before mutation when combat active (FlexibleCastingError on refusal); bonusActionSpent in result; tool/protocol text updated; new test/flexibleCastingCombat.test.ts (3 tests fail pre-fix). verify:worktree green.
